arms.balanced: Imported selected fixed initial-channel-balanced model; retained performance reference.
arms.baseline: Imported selected public-excited generic model; adoption context.
arms.candidate: One fresh full-cache-gradient safeguarded model per simulator.
arms.hold: Unchanged observed-state hold reference; physical scale only.
arms.safeguarded: Imported selected safeguarded minibatch-Adam model; direct mechanism control.

checkpoint_diagnostics.inherit: Keep the base initialization/weight witness roster, byte-exact initial identity, original and weighted train/development physical/channel/group reductions, coefficient diagnostics, source bindings, legitimate failed prefixes and11checkpoint roster. Historical imported checkpoints preserve original source/provenance and stochastic sampling semantics.
checkpoint_diagnostics.reuse: Privately rebind the pinned safeguarded observer to the new model, retaining the unchanged nested balanced/anchored/trajectory evidence. Use a bounded new attempt-chain validator for exact ordered full-cache indices and truthful gradient accounting. Do not mutate historical module globals, source, schemas or captured provenance. Aliases reuse prediction, initialization, weights, interpolation, objective evaluation and existing diagnostic reductions.
checkpoint_diagnostics.selection_scope: Only the imported selected reference models and originally selected new candidate receive held-out evaluation. No intermediate held-out checkpoint predictions, alternate selection, response-based tuning, second seed or restart.

cohort.collection: Reuse the same externally anchored excitation calibration collection and public 384/256 cached training/development windows. Preserve original generation physics/pilots, validity/admission/roles/query schedules, missing truth, weak probes and all planned rows. All selected models receive identical fresh test queries; no new or intermediate test-derived training data.
cohort.historical_disjointness: Authenticate original_protocol and base_protocol with all transitive anchors. Require the resolved base test IDs/seeds to equal original + 8000000 exactly and the new roster to equal original + 9000000. Expand original test IDs/seeds with each declared prior shift 0 through 8000000 and assert no overlap. Keep actual historical protocol anchors and evidence immutable; this roster check does not replace their source authentication.
cohort.recording_rule: Copy every resolved base_protocol recording. Calibration IDs/seeds/roles stay byte-exact. For test only, add 1000000 to seed and replace the matching terminal test-<oldseed> with test-<newseed>. This equals original two-simulator-flight-v1 test seed + 9000000. Assert 168 unique test IDs, 168 unique (simulator,seed) identities and 84 numeric seeds shared across simulators. Check IDs and seeds against all nine preceding cohorts before simulation.

angular_retention.statistic: The identical inherited hierarchical available-truth RMSE and linear-quantile parentRMSEp95, physical floors and shared query/mask rosters.

diagnostic_optimization_progress.source: At the originally development-selected checkpoint, divide the actual canonical cached full-training acceptance loss by its actual canonical initial acceptance loss; divide the actual weighted development selection loss by its actual initial weighted development selection loss. Do not substitute independent NumPy or posthoc diagnostic reductions. Both denominators must be positive and finite; otherwise report this diagnostic unavailable/false. A5%engineering margin, not an application-adequacy cap or test-derived target. No alternate checkpoint selection.

decision.failure: Keep all losses, missing truth and failed flags. Reject this full-cache-gradient candidate if physical criteria fail; do not infer all full-batch optimization ineffective. No post-result change to gradient roster/order, clipping, moments, ladder, objective, initializer, floor, data, seed, selector or test cohort. If improved training again fails to transfer, prioritize a separately frozen data-support/generalization mechanism over an unplanned optimizer extension.
decision.inherited_metrics: Use the authenticated base aggregation/floors/horizons/scope and simulator weights, paired parent bootstrap1000draws seed20260918, physical groups, truth masks, primary250ms tails, percondition reporting and availability rules verbatim.
decision.outcomes: Report all three comparisons, angular_retention and diagnostic_optimization_progress independently. residual_criteria_pass requires the three physical comparison gates, angular retention, finite predictions and matched cohorts. Completed research improvement requires residual_criteria_pass and independent integrity/replay/tamper/focused-test success. The optimization diagnostic is descriptive, separate, and does not veto physical progress. Do not silently retain the parent numerical_mechanism conjunction as this iteration acceptance rule. Public promotion remains false. No new quadratic-retention claim is made: that reference is absent from this cohort, and its historical evidence stays unchanged.
decision.prospective_policy: Margins apply only to this newly frozen cohort. Inherit public and balanced physical margins and broad guards unchanged; replace the quadratic comparison with the direct safeguarded control. The new safeguarded response target is a5%engineering progress margin. Preserve the prior optimization diagnostic thresholds but report them separately from physical acceptance. This prospective policy does not revise any earlier failed flags or infer application adequacy.
decision.qualification: Research success does not alter the public recipe. Fixed synthetic absolute caps and public fit/predict/update/save/load/JAX/interface/replay qualification remain separate, as do derivative fidelity, uncertainty, live updates and downstream control.

fitting.checkpoint_selection: At attempt0 and every100completed attempts through1000, evaluate the same weighted and original development loss from one shared recursive prediction. Select the first strict minimum finite weighted development loss, exactly as before. Record current parameters even when unchanged after rejection. Rejection counts never replace attempt indices. Original losses and physical diagnostics cannot select another model.
fitting.initialization: Execute the canonical anchored initializer once, with its existing affine and joint ridge solves once each. Actual candidate initial parameters/norms/original hold scales must equal the trusted balanced checkpoint0 byte-exactly. Do not substitute loading for initializer execution; do not rerun initialization for diagnostics.
fitting.matching: Exact recordings/caches/keys/origins/contracts/norms, parameter roster/shapes, initializer seed0, width32, memory8, learning_rate0.002,1000attempts, clipping5, Adam beta1=.9 beta2=.999 epsilon1e-8 and inherited operation order. The sole changed fitting setting is gradient-row selection: candidate uses every training window exactly once in saved order (384 for this benchmark), replacing each 64-window random draw. Candidate fitting recipe/settings report batch_size384; public and imported recipe64 metadata stay unchanged. Candidate minibatch_seed is null and gradient_sampling is ordered_full_cache. No optimizer sampling RNG is called; initializer randomness is unchanged.
fitting.objective: Exactly reuse the fixed initial-training inverse-channel-MSE objective and NumPy float64 construction from the base protocol. Recompute its one initial full-training forecast from the actual initializer once; require forecast/e0/raw weights/normalized weights/floor/normalizer and original scales byte-exactly equal to the imported balanced initial witness. Preserve explicit fixed stop-gradient weights and original hold normalization in optimization and selection.

optimizer.acceptance: Evaluate scales in the declared descending order. Accept the first finite full-training weighted loss < the cached current full-training weighted loss, with no Armijo term, tolerance, relative margin, development value or physical label. Cache the actually evaluated accepted loss. If all8fail, retain current parameters and cached loss exactly, with accepted_scale=0. Do not evaluate unused smaller scales after acceptance.
optimizer.compute_accounting: Report attempts started, gradient/proposal calls that actually returned, and completed acceptance attempts separately. Known gradient_window_visits equals actual cached window count times returned gradient/proposal observations (384000 for a complete benchmark fit, versus64000 in the saved direct control). An entered attempt with no returned proposal has unknown in-flight work, never fabricated completed visits. Count initial/trial acceptance-objective calls independently; the gradient-returned scalar is not another acceptance call. Preserve the existing one initial weighting forecast,11development calls and saved diagnostics separately. Record stage, fit/capture and diagnostic wall time. Where peak memory is available, label its process/platform scope; absence is explicit and never estimated. No equal-FLOP/time claim.
optimizer.full_training_evaluator: One pinned JIT full-training weighted-loss function, on all384 training windows and full native horizon with fixed norms/weights/scales, evaluates initial current parameters and every trial through the identical compilation/call path. Do not initialize its cached loss using the independent NumPy weighting reduction or a different eager/JIT loss path.
optimizer.gradient_loss_identity: Keep the scalar returned by the full-gradient call distinct from the canonical cached pre-proposal acceptance loss. Never substitute it into acceptance caching, comparisons or checkpoint selection. For every finite returned scalar, observer/evidence validation checks agreement with the pre-proposal full-training objective using inherited diagnostic rtol1e-10,atol1e-12; this tolerance is evidence-only and never alters strict < acceptance. Nonfinite optimizer values remain explicit numerical fit failures under the inherited policy.
optimizer.initial_order: After actual initialization and fixed weighting, record the finite initial weighted/original development checkpoint0 before evaluating the initial full-training acceptance loss. No proposal attempt is entered until both initial losses are finite. Earlier failures may retain a valid initial weight witness without checkpoint0 or any attempt.
optimizer.interpolation: Use one source-pinned canonical trial_parameters(current,proposal,alpha) helper in fitting and replay. alpha=1 returns the proposal arrays directly with identical bytes. Other scales compute current + alpha*(proposal-current) using the frozen JAX x64 tree arithmetic. Never replace alpha=1 with an algebraically equivalent subtract/add round trip.
optimizer.nonfinite: Nonfinite trial loss rejects that scale and permits the next declared scale; preserve that actual nonfinite observation explicitly. Nonfinite current baseline loss, minibatch loss, gradient/global norm, new moments or proposed parameters is an explicit numerical fit failure, never a rejected finite proposal. Preserve actual completed attempt/checkpoint prefixes and failure stage. Unknown errors or corrupt evidence abort the harness.
optimizer.proposal: At current accepted parameters execute one value_and_grad of the unchanged weighted mean over the entire cached training tensor (all windows, native forecast steps and output coordinates). The actual row index vector is int64 arange(len(train.past_states)), exactly 0..383 for this benchmark, once per proposal in saved order. No replacement, subset, shuffle, chunked gradient averaging or per-chunk clipping. Compute one global norm over the complete gradient, then apply the exact inherited g*min(1,5/(norm+1e-12)) clipping and unchanged Adam/bias-correction/proposal arithmetic. Advance moments and attempt counter once for every finite proposal, including complete rejection.
optimizer.time_limit: Measure monotonic elapsed wall time from fit_candidate_sequence entry before initialization, including initialization, compilation and observation. Wrapper cache preparation and post-fit calibration/diagnostic serialization are timed separately. Check before each attempt and after its completed acceptance decision; exceeding7200s ends an explicit fit_failure outcome with reason fit_time_limit, actual evidence prefix and no restart. A single in-flight call completes before the boundary check. This internal bound is distinct from the hard stage watchdog. Preserve the final elapsed check after the last development checkpoint and before successful return. Do not retry with a smaller batch or different seed on memory/time failure.

fitting.recipe: Reuse the exact generic recipe and full anchored quadratic geometry, with one new private full-cache-gradient-v1 archive identity, candidate internal batch_size384 and explicit ordered_full_cache metadata. The inherited public generic_recipe remains unchanged. No public API or consumer options.

imported_references.rule: Copy each full reference arm directory byte-exactly from prior_reference_bundle, preserving all selected models, original checkpoints, report/contract/cache/start/outcome/seal and nested source/runtime provenance. Historical candidate maps only at the new association level to safeguarded. Imported baseline/balanced keep their roles. Never relabel inner provenance or refit references. Use separate current runtime/data/source/import association records.
imported_references.verification: Authenticate the external root SHA first, then complete file rosters, every source/copy hash and bytes, frozen model revisions and model/checkpoint/seal anchors. Each historical checker uses its original protocol/runtime/expectations. Missing or altered references abort the harness; no refit, fallback, re-excitation or replacement optimizer.

named_gap: Test whether gradients over the complete training cache produce better proposal directions under the unchanged safeguarded weighted objective, and whether any gain transfers to physical forecasts and command responses.

optimizer_evidence.gradient_accounting: Derive attempts_started, gradient_proposal_calls_returned, completed_acceptance_attempts, known_gradient_window_visits and incomplete_gradient_work_unknown from actual observed boundaries. Complete runs require1000returned calls and384000visits; a started-but-not-returned call is unknown work. Require exact int64 arange(N) on each entered actual attempt, with N=384 in this benchmark. Invalid duplicate/missing/reordered indices or false64-window/seed/scope metadata is an integrity error.
optimizer_evidence.gradient_index_dtype_witness: At the actual started-attempt source marker, require an int64 index array and preserve its observed np.asarray(indices).dtype.str as gradient_indices_dtype alongside the serialized row list. JSON indices must have strict integer elements (not bool or float), lengthN and exact ordered values0..N-1. Validate the observed dtype explicitly; list equality or a declaration of int64 cannot substitute for an actual dtype witness.
optimizer_evidence.numerical_identity: Same-runtime canonical helper/forecast and stored proposal/cache/init/weights/checkpoint bytes replay exactly. Independent NumPy reductions retain the inherited rtol1e-10,atol1e-12 diagnostic tolerance only; it never changes strict < acceptance, selected steps or the finite trial roster.
optimizer_evidence.observation: Scoped read-only source/code-bound observer of actual fitter initializer/weight/checkpoint/attempt marker calls. Record actual ordered row indices, returned gradient/proposal scalar and norm, gradient/moment fingerprints, actual full proposal trees and completed trial/acceptance evidence. Preserve and restore prior tracing finally. No diagnostic gradients, optimizer calls or solves. No claim of independent gradient/Adam recomputation.
optimizer_evidence.partial_failure: Retain completed attempts plus any actual incomplete proposal/trial prefix with explicit unavailable fields and reason; never fabricate a full roster. A failure before first acceptance evaluation may have no attempts despite valid initializer/weight/checkpoint evidence. Nonfinite loss values use explicit status/null serialization so JSON never silently emits NaN/Infinity. Completed success and failure prefixes are externally bound to the sealed outcome.
optimizer_evidence.replay: Authenticate source/cache/initial/weight/reference anchors and replay saved actual proposal interpolation, full-training acceptance scalars, first strict acceptable prefixes and accepted/checkpoint parameter chains as before. Verify exact ordered arange(N) indices; do not generate random minibatches. Check finite full-gradient-returned scalar versus cached pre-proposal acceptance objective with declared diagnostic tolerance without using it for acceptance. Reconstruct actual counts and outcome including partial/nonfinite/time prefixes. Do not execute gradients, Adam, initialization, normal equations or an alternate optimizer. Moment and gradient fingerprints are observed continuity evidence only.
optimizer_evidence.storage: Use a compact proposal-array archive with stable leaf names/shapes/dtypes and an ordered scalar/index transcript, plus an explicit valid-length/partial-attempt schema. Do not save8full trial trees or predictions per attempt. Complete fits require exactly1000ordered completed attempts, a single initial loss and an exact prefix of the8scale roster at every attempt. Model report, transcript totals, source/cache/weight/init anchors, checkpoint values and outcome must agree. Complete runs additionally bind the ordered full-cache gradient descriptor and actual returned-work accounting to report/outcome/source and the saved transcript.
optimizer_evidence.wire_fields: The inherited minibatch_indices and minibatch_loss wire names may remain inside the new private versioned transcript, explicitly meaning ordered full-cache indices and full_training_cache_pre_proposal loss. Add an unambiguous gradient sampling/scope/accounting descriptor to the current envelope. Never reinterpret historical imported wire values as full-cache gradients.

resolution.inherit_historical_anchors: Retain all prior/previous bundle, protocol and result anchors needed by inherited calibration/source/replay helpers under their original names and meanings. prior_reference_bundle is the current import source; never repurpose prior_anchored_bundle or relabel its historical evidence.
resolution.no_stale_claims: Resolved current-fit descriptions must say ordered full-cache gradients under unchanged safeguards/objective. No optimizer sampling RNG, current reference fits or new weighting intervention. Current evaluation arms are baseline, balanced, safeguarded, candidate and hold; no quadratic arm or quadratic-retention claim. Historical roles, schemas and archived fitting recipes keep their original meanings.
replace_explicitly: fitting arm descriptions and optimizer mechanism
decision comparison roster and outcome rules
fresh confirmation and recordings test IDs/seeds
candidate gradient batch/seed/sampling metadata and actual work accounting
diagnostic optimization outcome no longer conjoined with physical improvement
resolution.rule: Authenticate the pinned parent protocol and all transitive anchors, then obtain its explicit resolved protocol through the pinned historical resolver. Construct the new compatibility view by declared field inheritance and replacements only, not a generic recursive merge. Save deterministic resolved JSON+SHA before generation/fitting and reconstruct it for integrity replay. Generation helpers that read the protocol path directly must receive the resolved view through a scoped adapter.

scope: Change only the rows used to form each Adam gradient: all cached training windows once in their saved order, replacing a 64-window draw with replacement. Keep architecture, initializer, fixed weights, normalization, Adam/clipping/acceptance arithmetic and development selection fixed. This changes gradient computation, not data support. Do not claim equal compute, that stochastic noise is proven to be the cause, or that lower training loss establishes generalization.

verification.attempts: Preserve every production/audit attempt script, log, exit status and scientific outcome. Auxiliary corrections cannot alter the frozen source, evidence, fits, selection, cohort or acceptance gates. All original sealed bundles stay unchanged.
verification.lean_implementation: Three new research modules and corresponding focused tests: full_cache_gradient_model, full_cache_gradient_checkpoints and full_cache_gradient_experiment. Reuse pinned predictor/initializer/weight/acceptance/metric/diagnostic code through private module adapters. Bounded copies of the fitter and attempt-chain validator are allowed where sampling is embedded; do not copy entire historical modules or fabricate legacy sampling data for validation. No historical edits, public options or platform branches.
verification.replay: Reproduce fresh simulator/query truth and selected-model predictions for both simulators; authenticate each imported reference under its original source/runtime/checker. Replay current initialization/weight/checkpoint diagnostics and every actual proposal trial loss/acceptance chain without refitting. Independently reduce saved physical errors, objective arrays, ordered gradient row witnesses and observed work counters. All altered source/import/cache/init/weights/indices/returned-loss/counters/proposals/trials/acceptance/state/checkpoint/decision artifacts must reject, including coherent local resealing. Full-gradient/Adam arithmetic is proven by source-bound execution and independent toy tests, not falsely claimed as recomputed in saved-run replay.
verification.source_binding: Authenticate all transitive base protocol and prior root source inventories, then add every new module and focused test and the frozen delta protocol identity to the current runtime map before fitting. Freeze protocol first; commit and test the full implementation before simulation/fitting. Source-bound observer and canonical helper identities are execution evidence, never unverified placeholders.

stage_supervision.scope: Every generation, fitting plus evidence serialization, evaluation, finalization and replay command has a14400s process watchdog. This explicitly exceeds the7200s internal fitter boundary and permits in-flight completion and post-fit evidence work. A hard watchdog termination is an incomplete stage, not a serialized fit_time_limit or a completed scientific result; preserve all available on-disk artifacts/logs and identify any unpersisted witness prefix as unavailable. Never fabricate missing observations, claim complete replay or restart the same fit automatically.

verification.tests: Meaningful asymmetric toy tests prove all-N ordered row coverage, actual complete-objective gradient and one global clip, exact inherited Adam arithmetic for multiple steps with active/inactive clipping, unchanged initialization/weights/alpha1bytes, plain-versus-observed parity, rejection moment advancement, finite/nonfinite distinction, timeouts and incomplete prefixes. Reject duplicate/omitted/reordered indices, false64-window/seed/scope/call metadata, altered trial/acceptance/report/checkpoint chains and coherently resealed artifact mutations. Validate complete and partial returned-gradient accounting separately. Original historical imported checker behavior/globals remain unchanged; no fitting or solves during replay. Include float/bool JSON index entries and a false observed dtype among index-witness rejection cases.
